name: UHT Treated Vanilla Flavoured Skimmed Milk
ingredients_raw: Skimmed Milk (80%), Water, Sugar, Milk Solids, Emulsifier & Stabilizer (INS 471, INS 407, INS 412, INS 415), Nature Identical Flavouring Substances (Vanilla), Acidity Regulator [INS 339(iii)], Vitamins (A & D). Allergens: Contains milk. Manufactured in a facility processing milk, nuts & cereals containing gluten.
